           DOLICHOS PRURIENS

         Cowhage

        (DOLICHOS PURIENS - MUCUNA)


A right-sided medicine, with pronounced liver and skin symptoms. A
        general   intense itching   without eruption. Exalted
        nervous sensibility. Senile pruritus. Hæmorrhoidal diathesis.



Throat.--    Pain in throat, worse
        swallowing, below right angle of jaw, as if splinter were imbedded vertically  .
        Pain in gums prevents sleep.



Abdomen.--  Colic from getting feet wet.   Constipation,
        with intense itching; bloated abdomen  . White stools. Swelling of liver.   Hæmorrhoids  , with burning sensation.



Skin.--    Intense itching  ,
        with no swelling or rash; worse across shoulders, also about elbows and knees and hairy
        parts. Jaundice. Yellow in spots; itching excessively at night. Herpes zoster (  Ars  ).



Modalities.--    Worse  , at
        night, scratching, right side.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Rhus; Bell;
        Hep; Nit ac; Fagopyr  .



Dose.--  Sixth potency. Tincture, drop doses, in hæmorrhoids.
